items.note: The letter is addressed to "Dear Ms. Alvarez."
Apartment 4B appears in both the subject line and the body.
It says the heater "stopped working on October 2."
It says "I called you on October 3 and have not had a response."
It says "Overnight temperatures are in the 40s °F."
It asks to "have the heater repaired within 48 hours."
It says "section 12 of my lease requires you to provide heat."

The tone is polite ("Dear," "Please," "Thank you") and firm, with a set deadline and a reference to the lease. The line "no preference on timing" applies only to when the visit happens, so it doesn't weaken the 48-hour demand.
The letter does not mention withholding rent or any other threat.
The full message is about 80 words, which is under the 150-word limit.
